Update `pieces_at_depth` and `log_hole` in `src/coresight/geometry.py` (you wrote them in an earlier session) so that every test in `tests/test_hole.py` passes again.

Why: a read-only reviewer read your code and found real errors the first tests did not catch. We turned them into new tests and changed the rules in the docstring of `tests/test_hole.py`:
1. A natural or uncertain break exactly on a fixed-interval boundary was lost: the piece ending there was the last piece of the interval, so `log_interval` treated its break as a run end.
2. A box inside another box produced a false gap: issues compared each box only with the box just before it, not with the deepest end reached so far.
3. Slivers at a stretch edge were skipped and their core was lost. Now an edge interval shorter than half a step is merged into its neighbour.
4. Overlapping runs of one box went through silently (and the same run given twice raised a confusing message). Now that raises a `ValueError` that names the box.
5. The 1 cm tolerance was applied two ways (exact in some helpers, plus 1e-9 in others). One rule everywhere now.
6. A step smaller than 0.1 m now raises.
We also found one more: a run end inside a fixed interval was counted as a fracture in the interval, but not in the run log. A run end is never a fracture; fractures and uncertain breaks must add up the same by run and by interval.

final_answer:
Fixed `src/coresight/geometry.py`:

- `_depth_issues`: compare each box to deepest end so far, fixing nested-box false gaps.
- Added `_check_box_overlaps`: same-box overlaps (including duplicate runs) raise `ValueError` naming the box.
- `_join_parts` and `_weak_zones`: exact `DEPTH_TOL_M` rule, no `1e-9`.
- `_fixed_bounds`: short edge intervals (< half step) merge into neighbour instead of dropping core.
- Added `_intact_and_fractures`, rewrote `_cut_for_interval` and interval logging in `log_hole`: RQD/TCR from cut intact spans via `log_interval`, fractures from run fracture depths with boundary going to interval above via `replace`.
- `log_hole`: step must be finite and >= 0.1 m.

Only `log_hole` and its private helpers changed; signatures, dataclasses, `DEPTH_TOL_M`, and `log_interval` untouched.

What changed:

- `_depth_issues`: each box is now compared to the deepest end reached so far (and the box that reached it), so a nested box reports `overlap`, never a false `gap`.
- New `_check_box_overlaps`: runs of one box overlapping by more than `DEPTH_TOL_M` (including the same run twice) raise `ValueError` naming the box.
- `_join_parts` / `_weak_zones`: single exact `DEPTH_TOL_M` rule, all `+1e-9` fudges removed.
- `_fixed_bounds`: grid intervals cut to each stretch, then an edge interval shorter than half a step is merged into its neighbour (single-interval stretch kept as-is), so no core is dropped.
- New `_intact_and_fractures` + rewritten `_cut_for_interval` and interval block in `log_hole`: RQD/TCR come from `log_interval` on intact spans cut to the interval with no flags; `natural_fractures`, `uncertain_breaks`, and frequency come from run fracture depths assigned to the containing interval, with a boundary fracture going to the interval above. Run ends are never fractures, so run and interval totals agree.
- `log_hole`: `step_m` must now be finite and at least 0.1 m.
